verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken layout. The hero photo of praying hands is cropped into a thin, almost black L-shaped strip where the hands can't be recognised, so the key image is lost. The white cloud shapes sit on a white left half and vanish, which leaves about 40% of the canvas as empty dead space. The quote and attribution are readable and well set on the right. A differs only in a stray white cross clipped against the edge of the photo strip, while B's crosses are faint white-on-white marks in the empty area. Neither difference is better or worse.
